title: LoRA is All You Need for Safety Alignment of Reasoning LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks focused on safety (refusing to answer harmful questions) and reasoning capabilities (in mathematics, science, and code generation).
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion. Its key finding is that applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) during safety fine-tuning can mitigate the 'Safety Tax,' preserving a model's reasoning performance while enhancing its safety, particularly when the base reasoning task is high-rank and the safety fine-tuning task is low-rank.
references: Alon, G. and Kamfonas, M. Detecting language model attacks with perplexity. arXiv preprint arXiv:2308.14132, 2023.
